'''Bill Turner''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Turner Metallics Inc''' in the permit-locked '''Alioth''' system. He specialises in [[Plasma Accelerator|Plasma Accelerators]], [[Sensors]], scanners, and several exploration and support modules.<ref name="edwiki-bill">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Bill_Turner Bill Turner], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Bill provides '''Grade 5''' engineering for Plasma Accelerators, Sensors, and the [[Detailed Surface Scanner]]. Most of his conventional support-module services reach Grade 3, while current Live records add three Operations-era blueprints at grades appropriate to their module families.<ref name="inara-bill">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/19/ Bill Turner — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Alioth
* '''Body:''' Alioth 4 a
* '''Facility:''' Turner Metallics Inc
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship weapons, scanners, and support modules
* '''Referral required:''' [[Selene Jean]]
* '''System permit required:''' Yes — Alioth

== Access requirements ==

Access to Bill Turner has four parts:<ref name="inara-bill" /><ref name="edwiki-bill" />

# Reach '''Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4''' with [[Selene Jean]] to receive his referral.
# Reach at least '''Friendly''' reputation with the '''Alliance'''.
# Gain '''Allied''' reputation with the '''Alioth Independents''' and obtain permission to enter Alioth.
# Provide '''50 units of Bromellite''' at Turner Metallics Inc.

Alliance superpower reputation and reputation with the Alioth Independents are separate requirements. The system permission is also practically necessary because Bill's workshop is inside Alioth.

Bromellite is a mined commodity. Its distribution belongs to the commodity's reference data, while equipment, prospecting, refining, and collection mechanics belong to [[Mining]]. The complete ordered access process belongs to [[Unlocking Bill Turner]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Bill Turner increases by:<ref name="inara-bill" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* selling commodities at Turner Metallics Inc.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Bill supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-bill" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add three Operations-era services to Bill's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-bill" />

* '''Extended''' [[Cargo Rack]] engineering through Grade 4<ref name="inara-cargo">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/206/ Cargo Rack — Extended], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Long Range Detailed''' [[Detailed Surface Scanner]] engineering through Grade 5<ref name="inara-dss">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/205/ Detailed Surface Scanner — Long Range Detailed], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''Scoop Rate Enhanced''' [[Fuel Scoop]] engineering through Grade 3<ref name="inara-scoop">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/201/ Fuel Scoop — Scoop Rate Enhanced], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. Their exact modifiers, costs, and module compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records rather than this Engineer article.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Bill Turner blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade he offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Bill Turner has no currently documented direct downstream Engineer referral. Other branches of the network can be followed through [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
